name.ja: エリザベス・ブラックウェル

overview.en: Elizabeth Blackwell was the first woman to receive a medical degree in the United States, breaking the gender barrier in Western medicine.

early_life.en: Born in Bristol, England, she emigrated to America with her family and decided to pursue medicine after a dying friend said she would have been spared embarrassment by a female physician.

impact.en: She opened doors for women in medicine by establishing the New York Infirmary for Indigent Women and Children and a medical college for women.

event.en: Became the first woman to receive a medical degree in the United States from Geneva Medical College
Founded the New York Infirmary for Indigent Women and Children
Established a medical college for women

title.en: Pioneer Work in Opening the Medical Profession to Women

description.en: Autobiography describing her struggle to enter medicine

text.en: It is not easy to be a pioneer, but oh, it is fascinating!

quotes.source: Pioneer Work in Opening the Medical Profession to Women
